facts: Sweden notified the EU Council (doc 8113/26, April 2026) of prolonged internal border controls 12 May 2026 - 11 Nov 2026 (previous period 12 Nov 2025 - 11 May 2026). Controls are renewed in 6-month steps; the Oresund bridge being a control point in 2026 is not confirmed by a 2026 source (only 2016 documents). Current period expires 11 Nov 2026 and is likely to be renewed.

UK ETA fee rose from GBP 16 to GBP 20 on 8 April 2026. ETA covers Jersey, Guernsey and Isle of Man for direct arrivals from outside the Common Travel Area: applications opened 9 April 2026, requirement applies from 23 April 2026 (secondary sources VisasNews, Guernsey govt statement 30 March; no gov.uk page found). Validity 2 years or until passport expiry (not re-verified on gov.uk). Travellers entering via the UK mainland already hold the ETA.
Same as S3: GBP 20 since 8 April 2026; single ETA also valid for Isle of Man for direct travel from 23 April 2026.

(a) Cusco: no international flights; Chinchero airport only ~40% complete in Jan 2026, opening projected late 2027/early 2028; international travellers connect via Lima - correct. (b) New Jorge Chavez terminal opened 1 June 2025 (soft launch from 15 May 2025), not June 2026 - route text is wrong on the year. (c) Lima state of emergency / neighbourhood risk levels: not verified (search returned nothing).
replacement: Lima's Jorge Chavez airport has a single new terminal (opened 1 June 2025), so the international-to-domestic connection to Cusco no longer involves a terminal change; there are no direct international flights into Cusco (new Chinchero airport not expected before 2027-28).

facts: Lima state of emergency for crime and Miraflores/San Isidro/Barranco low-risk claim: no source found in search; check FCDO/Buitenlandse Zaken before departure.

Thailand closed the land crossings 23 June 2025 (18 crossings). A guide dated 7 Oct 2026 says no reopening announced, no tourist exceptions at Poipet/Aranyaprathet or Hat Lek-Cham Yeam, citing a UK FCDO update of 28 Sept 2026 that land borders remain suspended. A cambojanews item mentions a possible phased reopening in Chanthaburi/Trat (undated, unconfirmed). Wording 'ceasefire since late 2025' not re-verified.

VOA and e-VOA are both IDR 500,000 (about USD 28, about EUR 26-29) for 30 days, extendable once (60 days total). Aug 12 2026 proposal to raise e-VOA to IDR 750,000 and VOA to IDR 1,000,000; not confirmed in force (RRI wording ambiguous). Prices of EUR 30 and 53 are too high/inconsistent.
replacement: Indonesia visa on arrival / e-VOA: IDR 500,000 (about EUR 29) for 30 days; a rise to IDR 750,000 (e-VOA) was proposed in Aug 2026 - check evisa.imigrasi.go.id before booking.

facts: Third-party 2026 guides: e-Tourist 30-day USD 25 (USD 10 in Apr-Jun low season), 1-year USD 40, 5-year USD 80; bank/transaction charge about 2.5-3% on top (4% PayPal). Not confirmed for Dutch nationals on the official portal (indianvisaonline.gov.in). Roughly EUR 22 (30-day, high season) and EUR 36 (1-year) incl. fees, so existing EUR 22 / EUR 36 prices are plausible.
